warning: A completed file is evidence only when authorized, timestamped, linked to backup/config/test output and independently reviewed.

prerequisites.check: Current encrypted off-host base backup is selectable
Continuous WAL range covers target timestamp
Restore credential is separate from application credential
Isolated host/network and storage capacity are available
Approved schema/config version and secret recovery process are available

steps.action: Declare incident or drill; freeze destructive automation; name commander and target timestamp.
Preserve failed host, volume, WAL, log and checksum evidence; never overwrite the only copy.
Provision isolated host and network; retrieve secrets through approved break-glass.
Restore base backup, replay WAL to target and verify PostgreSQL consistency and migration version.
Start maintenance or read-only mode; validate authentication, Published boundary, audit, outbox, search and evidence references.
Resume worker and writes only after approval; cut traffic, monitor, communicate, rotate exposed material and review.

validation.check: Admin OIDC/MFA/session and negative authorization tests pass
Only Published and Public DTO data reaches Guest responses
Schema version and database consistency checks pass
Audit append and privileged rollback behavior pass
Outbox backlog reconciles and worker idempotency passes
Search projection rebuild and representative Lao queries pass
Restricted evidence references and access remain correct
External HTTPS, monitoring and missing-telemetry alerts pass
